input.quote: Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Meets our preferred position on every limit (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, workers' compensation), for the term plus one year, with certificates on request and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities (18.2).

input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: Meets our preferred position: no minimum commitment or take-or-pay, express confirmation that declining to order is not a shortfall (2.1), no minimum-volume commitment (12.3) and a bar on minimum-use charges (7.1). The exclusivity in 2.2 could operate as a de facto lock-in, but we address that under EXCLUSIVITY rather than flagging the same term twice.

input.quote: Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Meets our preferred position: six months' transition assistance at expiring (not then-current) rates including migration support, 30-day return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format with no fee-dispute hostage (11.2), and secure deletion certified by an officer only after we confirm successful return (11.3).
